paite: Babulon kumpipa Belshazzar kum khatna kum in Daniel in alupna tung a alup lai in mang anei a, alungsim ah mengmuh ahong kilang a, mang agelh a athute akim in agen hi.
heading: Daniel Mengmuhnate / (7.1-12.13) / Daniel In Gamsa Lite Amuhna
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed: then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

paite: Daniel in thu agen a, "Zan a ka mengmuhna ah, ngai in, van huih lite tuipi thupi tung a hong nungkhia un ka mu hi.
english: Daniel spoke and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke forth on the great sea.

paite: Huan tuipi a kipan sa thupi li, kibang lou chiat ahong paitou ua,
english: Four great animals came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

paite: akhatna humpinelkai abang a, muvanlai kha anei hi; huchi a ka et lai in akhate bohkhiak in a-om ua; lei a kipan phottouh a mihing bang a khe nih a dinsak a om in; akiang ah mihing lungsim piak in a-om hi.”
english: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I saw until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand on two feet as a man; and a man’s heart was given to it.

paite: Huan ngai in, sa dang, anihna, vompi bang, apang langkhat tung ah photkang in a-om a; akamsung ah ahate kikal ah nakguh thum a-om a; hichibang in akiang ah hilh in a-om a, "Thou inla, sa tampi negai in," chi in.
english: Behold, another animal, a second, like a bear; and it was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth: and they said thus to it, Arise, devour much flesh.

paite: Hiai khit in ka en a, huan ngai in, sa dang khat, gialbem bang, anungzang a vasa bang a kha li nei ka mu hi. Huai gamsa in lu li anei a; akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi.
english: After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird; the animal had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

paite: Hiai khit in, zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in sa lina, lauhuai leh thilhihtheitak, nakpi mahmah a hat; sik ha lianpite nei in anegai in abotnen a; a-omlaite akhe in achil hi. Ama a gamsa om tengteng toh akibang kei; kii sawm anei hi.
english: After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, a fourth animal, awesome and powerful, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet: and it was diverse from all the animals that were before it; and it had ten horns.

paite: Kite ka ngaihtuah lai in, alak uah kii dang aneu khat hong poukhia a, huai ma ah huai kii masa thumte azung uah bohkhiak in a-om uh, hiai kineu ah mit, mihing mit bang leh kam thil thupite gen a-omta hi.
english: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots: and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

paite: Huchi a ka et lai in, laltutphah akikoih a, Tanglai Mipa'n alaltutphah aluahta hi; apu apuansilh vuk bang in angou a, samul siang bang in alu a sam angou hi; huai alaltutphah meikuang zuazua ahi a, huai akangtalai khete meikuang lai bang ahi.
heading: Tanglai Mipa Muhna
english: I saw until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat: his clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

paite: Meikuang luipi hong pawt a ama a kipan ahong paikhia a, asang asangte'n amah nna asepsak uh; ama ah singkhat mun singkhat adingh ua; vaihawmna atungkhia ua, laibute ahong uhi.
english: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousands of thousands ministered to him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

paite: Huai kii in athugen thupite ziak in ka en nilouh hi. Huchi a ka et lai in, huai gamsa thah in ahong om a; apumpi hihsiat in ahong om a; meikuang a apaih dong uh ka en gige hi.
english: I saw at that time because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke; I saw even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

paite: Huan sa dangte ahihleh athuneihna uh lakmang in a-om a; hun seh khat leh hun khat tan ahinna uh hihsau in a-om hi.
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

paite: Zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in, van meipite toh mi khat mihing tapa toh kibang ahong pai a, Tanglai Mipa kiang mahmah ah ahong a, amah ama chin ah ahon pi uhi.
english: I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

paite: Huan thuneihna, thupina leh gam piak in a-om a; huchi a mi tengteng, namte leh paute'n amah nna asepsak theihna ding un; athuneihna tangtawn thuneihna ahi a, amang kei ding, agam hihsiat in a-om kei ding hi.
english: There was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

paite: "Kei Daniel ahihleh ka sung ah ka lungsim adah a, ka lutang mengmuh in kei ahon patausak hi.
heading: Mengmuhnate Hilhchet Ahi Uh
english: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

paite: Akiangnai a dinghte lak a khat kiang ka zuan a, hiai tengteng thu ah thutak amah ka dongta hi. Huchi in huai thilte hilhchetna ka kiang ah ahon theisakta hi.
english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

paite: Hiai gamsa thupi lite etsak bel lei a hong dingkhe ding kumpipa lite ahi uhi.
english: These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who shall arise out of the earth.

paite: Himahleh Tungnungpen misiangthoute'n gam atang ding ua, tangtawn, tangtawn in, gam aneiden ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.

paite: Huchi in sa lina, amaute tengteng toh kibang lou, kihtakhuai mahmah, ahate sik hi a, achinte dal, ne khin a, botnen a, a-omlaite akhepek a chil tungtang thutak theih ka ut hi.
english: Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was diverse from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of brass; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

paite: Huan kii sawmte aluzang a omte lak ah kii dang khat hong poukhia a, huai ma a kii thumte apukna; huai kii mitte nei leh kam nei a thil thupite gen a, alatdan a lawite sang a hat tuakzaw pen tanchin ka thei nuam hi.
english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

paite: Huchi a ka etleh huai kii in misiangthoute dou in, gal abawl a,
english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

paite: Tanglai Mipa'n Tungnungpen misiangthoute gum in thu akhen a, amau lalgam aneih masiah ua ding in amaute azouta hi.
english: until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in sa lina pen leitung ah gam lina ahi ding a, huai gam tengteng toh akibang kei ding a, leitung pumpi agai ding a, asikden dia, abotnen ding achi hi.
english: Thus he said, The fourth animal shall be a fourth kingdom on earth, which shall be diverse from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

paite: Huan kii sawmte ahihleh, hiai gam a kipan in kumpipa sawm hong dingkhe dingte ahi ua; amau nung in adang khat; amasa toh akibang kei ding a, ama'n kumpipa thumte azou ding hi.
english: As for the ten horns, out of this kingdom shall ten kings arise: and another shall arise after them; and he shall be diverse from the former, and he shall put down three kings.

paite: Tungnungpen dem in agense ding a, misiangthoute anuaisiah ding hi; hunte leh dan khen ding angaihtuah dia; hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat abei masiah misiangthoute akhut ah piak in a-om ding uhi.
english: He shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High; and he shall think to change the times and the law; and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

paite: Huaite zoh in vaihawmna a-om ding a, athuneihna lakmang ahi ding a, atawp tan a hihgawp ding leh suksiat in a-om ding hi.
english: But the judgment shall be set, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

paite: Huan leitung gam leh thuneihna leh van nuai pumpi nuai a gamte thupina, Tungnungpen misiangthoute kiang ah piak in a-om ding; agam tangtawn gam ahi a, avaihawmnate'n amah nna asepsak un athu amang ding uhi.
english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High: his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

paite: Hiai ah thu leh la tawpna a-om hi. Kei Daniel ahihleh ka ngaihtuahnate'n nakpi in hon hihbuai a, kei ah ka mel amual hi; himahleh ka lungtang in huai thu ka kem khinkhian hi.
english: Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my face was changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
